symptom: my PCA9685 PWM driver isn't driving my servos. The board has A0 soldered.

files.pwm.py:
from board import *
from adafruit_pca9685 import PCA9685
i2c = I2C(scl, sda)
p = PCA9685(i2c)
p.frequency = 50

gold.diagnosis: i2cdetect shows the device at 0x41 (65). The PCA9685 base address is 0x40; with A0 soldered the address becomes 0x41. The adafruit_pca9685 driver defaults to 0x40. Pass address=0x41.
